issue.title: Warning: React.createElement: type is invalid when used with webpack code splitting

repository.name: react-input-mask
repository.description: Input masking component for React. Made with attention to UX.

issue.body:
When importing the component from separate code split bundles, *usually* the 2nd import will fail with this error:
`Warning: React.createElement: type is invalid -- expected a string (for built-in components) or a class/function (for composite components) but got: object.`

This will then continue to error out until the client cache is entirely cleared and the app reloaded, only to reoccur once a second bundle loads it again.

This is only an issue when using webpack (or similar bundler) that honors the package.json `module` import.

`import MaskedInput from 'react-input-mask'` will trigger the issue
`import MaskedInput from 'react-input-mask/dist/react-input-mask.min';` will **not** trigger the issue

This does not reproduce 100% of the time, but from my testing and debugging until I pinpointed the source being the import it occurred roughly 80% of the time we loaded it from a second bundle.

*Environment*
react 15.5.4
webpack 3.3.0
react-input-mask 1.0.6

*Additional information:*
webpack is configured to code split the application up into multiple lazy loaded bundles, and we use `commonschunkplugin` to move all shared node_modules to an async vendor bundle as well which is loaded along with the entry bundle.
